arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Konrad argued the protocol causes intense pain and suffering.
She stated the second and third drugs cause suffocation.
She claimed the method is constitutional only if pain is absent.
Chief Justice Roberts questioned the burden of showing factual errors.
